observation.sentence: `POST /owners/{ownerId}/pets/{petId}/edit`: warm median 3.4 ms over 367 requests; Handler, other work 49 %, Response write 34 %, Other filters 8 %. Median CPU 3.4 ms and 480 KB allocated per request.
whatToCheck: Most of the time is in the handler outside recorded calls: run Profile resources to see the route's hottest frames.
limitations: The journal evicted older events, so a route's first request may be gone and none is reported apart as cold.
